title: Concord Amboseli Lodge – Kimana
subtitle: 60-acre lodge property in the Amboseli ecosystem at Kimana – one of Africa's most iconic wildlife destinations – offering an established hospitality platform with significant upside from the booming Kenya wildlife tourism sector.
description:
The Amboseli ecosystem is Kenya's most photographed safari destination, globally renowned for its vast elephant herds set against the snow-capped backdrop of Mount Kilimanjaro – Africa's highest peak. Kimana is a key gateway community at the heart of the Amboseli–Tsavo wildlife corridor, offering game viewing, Maasai cultural experiences, and direct Big 5 access.

This 60-acre parcel bearing the Concord Amboseli Lodge development/operation provides a substantial landholding within this world-class wildlife destination. At 60 acres, the property has sufficient scale for a premium tented camp or lodge complex of 30–50 units, with expansive buffer land providing authentic wilderness privacy and scope for conservation land management. Kenya's wildlife tourism sector has experienced strong post-pandemic recovery, with Amboseli among the top-performing parks nationally. International visitor arrivals to Kenya exceeded 2 million in 2024, with luxury safari remaining one of the most resilient and high-yield segments globally.

At KES 3.3M per acre, this represents outstanding value for a titled hospitality parcel within the Amboseli ecosystem, where comparable properties transact at multiples of this figure in international markets.

title: Syokimau Gateway – JKIA Frontage Mixed-Use Megaplot
subtitle: Prime 5-acre mixed-use megaplot adjacent to Gateway Mall and JKIA – the single most strategically located large undeveloped land parcel in the Greater Nairobi Airport Zone, suited for a landmark hotel, upscale apartments, or logistics-integrated commercial campus.
description:
This 5-acre plot occupies what is arguably the most strategically valuable undeveloped land position in the entire Nairobi Metropolitan Area: directly adjacent to JKIA Gateway Mall, within metres of Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA) – East Africa's busiest international airport. Syokimau has transformed over the past decade from a satellite dormitory suburb into a fully-fledged commercial and residential node, driven by the SGR Syokimau terminus (commuter rail to CBD), proximity to JKIA, and Gateway Mall's role as the airport's commercial anchor.

A 5-acre parcel in this location can support a landmark airport hotel (200–300 rooms), premium transit-oriented apartments (200–400 units), a logistics park or bonded warehouse complex, a business park with serviced offices, or a phased mixed-use development combining all of the above. The JKIA node is the arrival and departure point for Kenya's entire international trade and tourism economy, guaranteeing perpetual demand for quality accommodation, services, and commercial space. At KES 200M/acre, this is the most commercially justified land price in the dataset given the catchment.
location: Syokimau, Behind JKIA Gateway Mall, Nairobi

title: 3rd Parklands Residential Villa – No. 10
subtitle: Premium residential villa on 3rd Parklands Avenue – a prime address commanding strong rental yields from Nairobi's Indian-origin business community, medical professionals, and expatriates.
description:
3rd Parklands Avenue is one of Nairobi's most established and desirable residential addresses, particularly favoured by Nairobi's large Asian business community, senior professionals, and expatriates working in the Westlands–Parklands commercial corridor. The avenue is characterised by manicured grounds, tree-lined streets, and a quiet residential character just minutes from major commercial hubs including Westlands, Sarit Centre, and Aga Khan University Hospital.

Villa No. 10 sits within a well-maintained 11-villa estate, offering the security, community, and management benefits of an established scheme while providing individual title for each unit. The 0.37-acre plot (1,497 sqm) is generous by Nairobi standards for a residential villa, supporting significant built area. At KES 50M, this represents highly competitive pricing for a 3rd Parklands address where comparable properties frequently list above KES 60–80M.

title: Maanzoni Estate – Plot 19689
subtitle: 4.82-acre undeveloped plot in Maanzoni Estate, Machakos – a scenic mid-altitude location on the Nairobi–Mombasa corridor, ideal for a leisure residential estate, eco-retreat, or conference resort targeting Nairobi weekenders.
description:
Maanzoni Estate is a well-regarded lifestyle and residential development area located in Machakos County along the Nairobi–Mombasa A109 highway. The area is characterised by open savannah landscapes, moderate altitude, and sweeping views that appeal strongly to Nairobi's upper-middle-income market seeking weekend retreats, holiday homes, and low-density residential alternatives outside the city.

This 4.82-acre parcel can be acquired individually or as part of a combined landholding. The Maanzoni market has been driven by Nairobi residents (approximately 60km away, ~60 minutes) seeking nature-oriented second homes and by institutional buyers looking for affordable hinterland land banks. Machakos County's ambitious infrastructure programme and SEZ ambitions further underpin long-term appreciation.

title: Malindi Beachfront Land – 3rd Row Malaika Beach (19 acres)
subtitle: 19-acre undeveloped landbank at Malaika Beach, Malindi – 3rd row from the ocean in one of the Kenya coast's most established Italian and European tourism markets, offering exceptional scale for a resort or residential development at a remarkably low entry price.
description:
Malindi is Kenya's oldest coastal resort town and remains the heartland of the Italian expatriate community along the Kenyan coast, which has been vacationing and investing here since the 1970s. Malaika Beach is one of Malindi's most recognised beach addresses, known for its white sand, coral reef access, and established resort and villa neighbourhood character. A 3rd-row position at Malaika Beach provides reasonable beach proximity (walkable distance) without the direct beachfront premium pricing.

At 19 acres, this is a large undeveloped coastal landbank suitable for a resort hotel of 80–150 keys, a residential beach villa estate of 30–60 plots, or an eco-resort. The scale of the parcel is a key differentiator – parcels of this size are increasingly scarce in established Malindi beach addresses. Malindi's tourism market benefits from direct charter flights from Italy (Malindi Airport) and a loyal repeat-visitor base. Post-pandemic coastal recovery, combined with growing domestic tourism from Nairobi's growing middle class, is reactivating demand. At KES 4.2M/acre, the entry valuation is exceptional for a titled Malindi coastal holding.

title: Malindi Beachfront Land – 2nd Row Malaika Beach (9 acres)
subtitle: 9-acre undeveloped plot at 2nd row Malaika Beach, Malindi – a closer-to-ocean coastal holding in a reviving Italian resort town, at a price that makes it one of the most affordable titled second-row coastal land opportunities on the Kenyan coast.
description:
This 9-acre parcel occupies the 2nd row at Malaika Beach – one position closer to the ocean than the adjacent 3rd-row parcel, yet priced at KES 40M, reflecting a combined discount to value that makes both parcels compelling together. As a standalone acquisition, the 2nd-row position offers stronger future sale value for any resort, hotel, or villa development due to the ocean proximity premium it carries.

The Malindi coastal market is characterised by European (particularly Italian) investors who have maintained a long-term presence in the area across multiple tourism cycles. The market is in recovery mode following COVID-19, supported by Italian charter traffic, growing domestic tourism, and Kenya's improving international air connectivity. A 9-acre 2nd-row site at Malaika Beach can accommodate a premium boutique resort of 40–60 keys with pool, restaurant, and beach access amenities. The low acquisition cost relative to the location quality represents an asymmetric risk-reward opportunity for a hospitality developer.

title: Kwale Farm – Majoreni Agricultural Land
subtitle: 155-acre farm in Kwale County's Majoreni area – a large-scale agricultural or agro-industrial landbank in coastal Kenya, adjacent to one of East Africa's fastest-growing logistics and investment corridors anchored by the Lamu Port–South Sudan–Ethiopia Transport (LAPSSET) corridor.
description:
Kwale County has undergone a fundamental economic transformation, driven by Titanium mineral extraction (Base Titanium mine), the growth of Diani as a premium tourism destination, and major infrastructure investments. Majoreni in Kwale provides fertile coastal hinterland land with potential for both commercial agriculture and longer-term conversion to industrial, logistics, or tourism-supporting uses.

At 155.68 acres, this is a large-scale agricultural holding with the critical mass necessary for commercial farming operations – sugarcane, cassava, tropical fruits, or biofuel crops – or the establishment of an agro-processing facility serving the coast's growing food demand. The holding's scale also makes it attractive to plantation developers, institutional land funds, or investors seeking a large-volume land entry into Kwale County at below-market per-acre pricing. At KES 1.28M/acre, this is among the most competitively priced large-acreage coastal land currently available.

title: Malindi Airport Adjacent Undeveloped Farm – 69 acres
subtitle: 69-acre undeveloped plot directly adjacent to Malindi International Airport – an exceptional aviation-linked landbank in Kenya's premier Italian coastal resort town, ideal for airport-oriented commercial, hospitality, or residential development.
description:
Adjacency to an airport is one of the most powerful value drivers in real estate globally. This 69-acre plot sits immediately next to Malindi International Airport, which currently handles charter flights (primarily from Italy), domestic connections to Nairobi/Mombasa, and light aircraft. Malindi Airport has been the subject of upgrade discussions in the context of growing Malindi tourism and the Kenya Airports Authority's national infrastructure programme.

A 69-acre airport-adjacent parcel of this size is rare in any Kenyan coastal town. The development possibilities are extensive: a transit hotel and conference centre serving air arrivals, a mixed-use development with retail, residential, and hospitality components, agricultural/horticultural production for air cargo export (Malindi's climate is ideal for tropical fruits and cut flowers), or a logistics and warehousing campus leveraging the airstrip for light freight. As Malindi's tourism market matures and international connectivity improves, the premium attached to airport-adjacent land will increase significantly.
location: Adjacent to Malindi International Airport, Malindi, Kilifi County

title: 6th Parklands Ring Road Undeveloped Plot
subtitle: Half-acre prime undeveloped plot on Ring Road in 6th Parklands – one of Nairobi's highest-demand residential and light commercial addresses, with strong development potential for luxury apartments or a boutique commercial building.
description:
6th Parklands is one of Nairobi's most exclusive and expensive residential addresses – a leafy, quiet neighbourhood that combines proximity to Westlands' commercial core with a distinctly premium residential character. Ring Road Parklands is a key arterial within this neighbourhood, providing excellent internal connectivity while maintaining the suburb's prestigious address value.

This half-acre plot at LR 209/9954 represents a clean development site in a location where land is almost never available. 6th Parklands commands the highest residential land values in Nairobi's northern suburbs, driven by demand from high-net-worth Kenyans of Asian origin, senior executives, diplomats, and professionals who value the suburb's security, greenery, and access to Aga Khan University Hospital, Westlands, and the CBD. A 0.5-acre plot on Ring Road supports a luxury apartment block of 8–16 high-end units or a boutique commercial building. The asking price of KES 280M (KES 560M/acre) is consistent with current 6th Parklands land market values.
location: 6th Parklands Avenue, Ring Road Parklands, Nairobi

title: South B – Dunga Road Mega Development Site
subtitle: 4.8-acre urban megasite on Dunga Road, South B, adjacent to Matter Hospital – a rare large-scale inner-city development opportunity with frontage, scale, and proximity to Nairobi's key southern commercial and healthcare corridor.
description:
This 4.8-acre undeveloped plot on Dunga Road, South B represents one of the largest single undeveloped land parcels available in Nairobi's inner-city market. South B is one of Nairobi's most densely populated and commercially vibrant southern suburbs, located at the convergence of Mombasa Road, Dunga Road, and the South B commercial strip. Its position adjacent to Matter Hospital – one of Nairobi's leading private hospitals – situates it within the emerging Healthcare–Commercial–Residential triangle that characterises Nairobi's high-density inner suburbs.

At 4.8 acres, the site has the critical mass for a genuinely transformational development: a multi-building mixed-use complex combining a neighbourhood retail strip mall, 200–400 apartment units across multiple towers, medical office space serving the hospital catchment, or a hotel catering to the medical tourism and business traveller market. The KES 2B asking price reflects the site's unmatched combination of scale, inner-city location, and proximity to anchor institutions. Comparable developments on similar-sized sites in Westlands, Upper Hill, and Hurlingham have delivered IRRs of 20–28% over 5–7 year development cycles.

title: Limuru Road Parklands Prime Development Plot
subtitle: 3.16-acre undeveloped prime plot on Limuru Road in Parklands – one of the largest remaining undeveloped parcels on Nairobi's most prestigious suburban arterial, ideal for a landmark residential or mixed-use development targeting the high-net-worth Nairobi market.
description:
Limuru Road is Nairobi's most coveted suburban address corridor, running through Parklands and connecting to Runda, Muthaiga, and Gigiri. It carries some of the highest residential land values in sub-Saharan Africa and is lined with prestigious estates, embassies, international school campuses, and corporate headquarters.

At 3.16 acres, this is a genuinely large undeveloped holding on Limuru Road – a size virtually impossible to assemble in this location through acquisition of multiple existing properties. The site is capable of accommodating a gated luxury apartment complex of 80–150 units across multiple blocks, a premium residential estate of 10–20 high-value villas, or an institutional campus development for a school, hospital, or embassy complex. Limuru Road Parklands commands sustained demand from Nairobi's most affluent residents and from international organisations who prize the location's prestige, security, and connectivity to Westlands, the UN complex, and the CBD.

The KES 1.6B asking price – while significant – is justified by the absolute scarcity of available undeveloped land of this size on Limuru Road. Comparable transactions on Limuru Road and in the upper Parklands corridor have established a land price floor well above KES 400M/acre.

title: Shelly Beach Resort – Beachfront Hotel Landholding (4 Parcels)
subtitle: Four-parcel 1st-row beachfront resort landholding at Shelly Beach, Mombasa's most iconic south-coast address – comprising approximately 12 acres with 300 metres of direct Indian Ocean beachfront and an established 200-room hotel footprint, representing one of East Africa's most significant coastal hospitality investment opportunities.
description:
Shelly Beach is arguably the most iconic coastal resort address in Kenya – a 1st-row Indian Ocean beachfront location that has defined Mombasa's coastal tourism identity for over five decades. The four combined parcels (Block V/69, V/71, V/76, V/77) form the landholding of Shelly Beach Resort, a landmark property with an established 200-room hotel footprint and approximately 300 metres of direct beachfront on the Indian Ocean.

The combined 12-acre multi-parcel holding delivers the rarest possible asset combination in East African real estate: substantial acreage, first-row beachfront position, established hotel infrastructure, and an iconic brand address, in the Indian Ocean coastal belt. The property is positioned for comprehensive refurbishment and repositioning as a premium 4–5 star coastal resort targeting international leisure tourists, wedding and MICE markets, and high-spending domestic travellers.

Mombasa's coastal tourism market has recovered strongly from the pandemic-era downturn, with beach resort occupancy rates trending upward throughout 2023–2025. International arrivals to Kenya surpassed 2 million in 2024, with the coast receiving the lion's share of leisure visitors. Shelly Beach's proximity to Mombasa's established tourism infrastructure – Moi International Airport (20 min), the old town, marine parks, and dhow cruise routes – positions a refurbished resort here to compete directly with the leading 4-star properties on the South Coast.

A complete refurbishment to international standard (200 rooms, beach club, spa, conference facilities) could position Shelly Beach Resort as Mombasa's definitive urban beach resort – combining city convenience with beachfront luxury in a way no competitor currently achieves.
